androidtv.notes: Up Next: near the end of an episode a card shows the next one with a countdown, with Play now and a way to keep watching the credits. New episode alerts: shows you're watching are marked and come first in Continue Watching when a new episode is out.

phone.notes: Up Next: near the end of an episode a card shows the next one with a countdown, with Play now and a way to keep watching the credits. New episode alerts: shows you're watching are marked and come first in Continue Watching when a new episode is out, and your phone gets a notification.
